description: Unregister an autoload from a project by name. Use to recover from an autoload that stops the engine before headless operations are dispatched. No Godot process is used. Returns: removed (the name) and autoloads[], the entries that remain, read back from project.godot. Errors if no autoload has that name.

autoloadName.description: Name of the autoload to remove

projectPath.description: Path to the Godot project directory

name: remove_autoload

path.description: res:// path of the script or scene.

removed.description: Name of the autoload that was removed.
